title: chromolaena pedalis
intro: Chromolaena pedalis, commonly known as Eupatorium, is a flowering plant species native to the Americas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena pedalis include analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, making it useful in relieving pain, muscle spasms, and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Chromolaena pedalis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
